note: Mission-fit table (F8A Task 10 2026-10-16, extended by F8B 2026-10-17): hand-transcribed from F3 section 4, one row per chapter. A 'filled' row has a start, a first-action point and a cruise speed in world terms and is checked by tests/sim/missionFit.test.ts against the real site layout within `ceilingS` at 1x; a 'pending' row names the F8 plan that closes it and why. A row with `recovery` also checks the flight home to the nearest named field that is LEGAL in the window the chapter plays in (held by the player's side and serviceable, F3 section 2) against F3's recovery budget; `withinM` is F3's own range where it gives one. A failing row is a finding to report, never to tune (Mark, 2026-10-16): it carries `expectFail`, and the test asserts it still fails that check. Every constant (cruise, taxi, roll, landing allowance) and every start or first-action point F3 does not locate is an ESTIMATE or INVENTED, labeled in its row.

rows.f3: launch from Essex; raid contact inside 15 mi; first action 3-4 min

rows.reason: Starts afloat at the San Pedro Bay anchorage, an F8C site.

Replace with the authored contact point.

F3 gives no geometry for this point; invented, and labeled so, as F8A did for A6. Replace with the authored point when F10 places the action.

start.note: F3 J3: the player orbits a column bound for Burauen but gives no position; invented as 7,000 m west of the Buri runway center (the road from the west), at cruise speed.

firstAction.note: F3 J3: four P-38s attack in two waves 2-3 min in, over a road column heading for the Buri dispersal zone; the first wave's contact point is invented as 3,500 m west of Buri. F3 gives no geometry for this point; invented, and labeled so, as F8A did for A6. Replace with the authored point when F10 places the action.

expectFail.why: F3 section 3 says J3 is 3 Nov and recovers at Bayug; F3 section 5 puts 3 Nov in the 'late Oct-Nov' column, where Bayug is American ('limited American dry-weather use continues'). A Japanese pilot cannot land at an American field, so J3's authored recovery is not a legal field in the window the F8 table plays it in. Geometry is fine (Bayug is about 4 km from the first action). Only Mark or F3 can settle it: play J3 in pre-invasion for the Burauen fields, or change F3.

rows.f3: airborne start orbiting the column; first action 2-3 min; recovery Bayug in 3-5 min
